meaning: because (I was busy) doing …, so something else didn't happen
nuance: The first clause is an activity that took up time or attention; the result is usually something missed. Both clauses share the same subject.

contrasts.note: -는 바람에 is a sudden outside event; -느라고 is your own time-consuming activity.

examples.en: I was doing homework, so I couldn't answer the phone.
I was swamped getting ready to move.

cloze.en: I was watching a movie last night, so I didn't get any sleep.
